name: dev-pipeline
description: Autonomous ticket-to-PR pipeline across intake → build → review → merge-boundary blocks, gated by lean's five artifact milestones by default — a thin scheduler (/dev-pipeline:run-lean) over payload blocks that stay individually invokable (/dev-pipeline:build-lean, /dev-pipeline:review-lean); the ten-stage statectl state machine (/dev-pipeline:run) is kept as an ablation/rollback lane. Deterministic verify runner (verifyctl), plan lint with AC traceability, tracker adapters (github|jira), Workflow-based review/plan/mutation gates, cost tracking, retro. Reads per-repo static context from .claude/second-shift.config.json.
